channel.title: Homeowners of Texas — Homeowner Watch
channel.description: Automatically refreshed Texas homeowner data and legislative activity.

item.title: HB 1086 Introduced
item.description: Relating to prohibiting the provision or use of public money to fund certain legal services for aliens unlawfully present in the United States; providing a civil penalty.

item.title: HB 1104 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the authority of the chief appraiser of certain appraisal districts to consider a property to be a comparable property when using the market data comparison method of appraisal to determine the market value of a residence homestead for ad valorem tax purposes.

item.title: HB 1108 Introduced
item.description: Relating to mandatory sales price disclosure in commercial and industrial real property sales; providing a civil penalty.

item.title: HB 1112 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the approval or disapproval of certain construction-related permits and authorizations by a political subdivision.

item.title: HB 1115 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the effects of unresponsive insureds for a personal automobile insurance policy.

item.title: HB 1116 Introduced
item.description: Relating to recoverable depreciation for property damage claims under an insurance policy.

item.title: HB 1117 Introduced
item.description: Relating to binding arbitration provisions under a property and casualty insurance contract.

item.title: HB 1118 Introduced
item.description: Relating to requirements for commercial and residential property insurance policies regarding coverage for a structure other than the primary structure covered under the policy.
